description: Aggressive UPI adoption and campaign expanded small-ticket digital transactions.
Third-party IP reputation feed updated and several low-risk IP ranges were reclassified.
Device fingerprint spoofing campaign targeted mobile user sessions.
Mobile app redesign changed session and channel telemetry capture behavior.
Fraud review queue delay created labeling lag and stale supervisory labels.
Higher UPI transaction limits increased high-value transfer patterns.
Inflation elevated transaction sizes and risk asymmetry.
Cross-border mule activity increased and bypassed geo heuristics.
Model library update introduced threshold-shift behaviour in the production pipeline.
Missed fraud cases were later treated as legitimate labels and reintroduced to retraining.
